simple.summary: דֻּמָּה (dummâh) means desolation ; concretely, desolate First listed occurrence: Ezek 27 32.

definitions.full: H1822. dummah דֻּמָּה noun feminine one silenced, brought to silence (?; destroyed?) הַיָּ֑ם בְּתוֺךְ כְּדֻמָּה כְצוֺר מִי Ezek 27:32 (form pecul. & sense dubious: Baer כְּדֻמָֿה ; Co כְּבֻדָּה from כָּבֹד adjective, compare 23:41 ; Psa 45:14 ) AV What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed (as though for מְדֻמָּה compare ההללה 26:1 ; but Pi`el Punic not elsewhere) in the midst of the sea? RV like her that is brought to silence. — Dl Baer Ezech p.xi. & Pr 64 derived, hesitantly, from II. דמם .
